name: Anouska Leibovici
title: Corporate trainer and leadership coach
bio_short: Corporate trainer and leadership coach with more than 24 years' experience in senior management, sales and hospitality. Former Director of Operations at Hotel Dynamics Middle East. Delivers training in leadership, communication and events.
bio: Anouska is a corporate trainer and leadership coach with more than 24 years' experience in senior management, sales, marketing and hospitality. She specialises in helping individuals and teams develop practical skills in public speaking, presentation, leadership, communication and interpersonal effectiveness. Her training style is engaging, energetic and focused on immediate application.  Anouska's career includes senior roles across the hotel and travel industry. As Director of Operations for the Middle East at Hotel Dynamics, she was responsible for 16 hotel loyalty programmes across five-star properties throughout the region, managing more than 400 employees. She also served as Client Services Director at Karak Creative, a Dubai agency, and held business development and marketing leadership positions at IFA Hotels and Resorts, Power Brands Hospitality and IML Field Marketing Services.  At ISOC, Anouska delivers training in public speaking, presentation skills, management and leadership, communication skills, assertiveness, crisis and reputation management and event management. Her courses consistently receive five-star feedback. She brings a hands-on, results-driven approach that draws on real experience of leading large teams, developing client relationships and managing operations under pressure. Anouska is based in Spain and Dubai and trains in English.
